north_star: Prometeo should turn human intent into durable useful product change while allowing many disposable chats to work in parallel without duplicating capabilities or forgetting important discoveries.

routing_rules.branch_head_check: Compare actual branch head with PACK/LAST_RETURN before material work.
routing_rules.stale_return_recovery: If a parallel chat advanced the branch without updating LAST_RETURN, inspect only commits after the last known head, synthesize the missing useful delta, update the single LAST_RETURN, and continue. Never respond by rereading the whole repository.
routing_rules.no_match: Use Catalog to identify the target, inspect only recent commits touching that target if needed, then create one small scoped PACK before material work; do not invent a new global architecture.

active_workstreams.title: Calendar / habits / money integrated preview
active_workstreams.note: Recent parallel work landed directly on main. New routed work should use the scoped work branch so experimentation stops colliding with unrelated chats.

efficiency.planning_rule: Plan only enough to change execution. If a plan is already frozen, execute it.
efficiency.verification_rule: Batch cheap checks after meaningful change. A check does not count as product progress.
efficiency.loop_breaker: After the same strategy fails twice without new evidence, change strategy rather than adding more checks.
